escalations.details: ai-git push argument-reordering bug (push -u / push ... -u) echoed the live AI_GIT_TOKEN in an authenticated URL to stdout and persisted it into a worktree's local .git/config during PR creation for chunk 012. Self-remediated locally (config reset to origin, no token string remains in that worktree). This is the second confirmed occurrence (first: 2026-08-18, chunks 001/002/004/008, which led to a token rotation that day) and the bug in lib/ai-git.js has not been fixed since. Needs human decision: (1) rotate AI_GIT_TOKEN again, and (2) whether to authorize a chunk plan to fix lib/ai-git.js's push-argument handling (Software-Engineer domain per AIF-PROC-001). RESOLVED: human approved a direct, ad hoc, human-confirmed fix (no formal Plan ID -- small contained security bugfix, per chat approval 2026-08-23) outside AIF-002's own chunk scope. Software-Engineer root-caused it (lib/ai-git.js's injectAuthUrl only checked args[1], mishandling -u immediately after `push`) and fixed it structurally: replaced URL-embedded token injection with a transient `-c http.<scope>.extraheader=...` Basic-auth header override, passing the caller's push/fetch args through completely unchanged -- auth injection is now argument-order-independent by construction, so the token can never appear in a URL for git to echo or persist. Added unit tests across multiple -u/--set-upstream orderings and an integration test asserting the token never appears in captured stdout/stderr or .git/config. Committed 5543cc4 directly to main (framework repo direct-commit workflow). npm test 629/629 passing, independently re-confirmed by Engineering-Manager. AI_GIT_TOKEN rotation itself is a human action outside EM's tool access -- still recommended as a precaution but not performed by EM.
